review_redaction.purpose: Reviewer-facing derived copy (decision D-EXPORT-03), not the frozen file. Observed fields (outcomes of probes, smokes and pilots, token counts, real costs, real-run dates, corrections about earlier reports, paths under runs/) are removed; every settings field is unchanged.

scope: Claude Sonnet 5 pilot: 192 calls on the 12 DeepSeek pilot items, both arms. Full collection not covered.

model.endpoint: Anthropic SDK default base URL (first-party API)
model.lifecycle: Active, with retirement declared not before 30 June 2027 (confirmed by the researcher on 2026-10-21).

request_settings_on_the_wire.messages: one user message per request, plus the system field on the Camuffo arm, exactly as assembled from the catalogue for the manifest row and its label order. Each request is independent. The three S repeats of a cell carry byte-identical messages and parameters.

client.sdk_retries: max_retries=0 on the client; the runner makes one attempt per task
client.timeout_note: python/scripts/chapter3_execute.py, SDK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, for connect, read, write and pool. A timeout is an API error without HTTP status: it stops the segment and is never retried.

design_deviation.carlson: The design asks for T=0. Sonnet 5 receives no temperature and decodes at its default. This deviates from the Carlson replication on this model and must be reported.
design_deviation.camuffo: The design asks for T=1, which is the documented default; the parameter is still not sent.
design_deviation.recorded_as: temperature_requested 0 or 1, temperature_parameter_sent null, temperature_control 'unavailable', sampling_parameters_policy 'omit'. The omitted parameter is not a verified control of temperature.

parse_errors: terminal missing values: the raw output is kept verbatim, the slot is consumed, and nothing is retried or reinterpreted

tariff.confirmed: 2026-10-21, by the researcher on the official pages; the values equal the snapshot.
tariff.code: python/src/chapter3/first_party.py, TARIFFS[snapshot_id]; the test suite checks the two agree

cost_estimate.formula: input_tokens x input + cache_read_input_tokens x cache_read + cache writes by TTL (5m x cache_write_5m, 1h x cache_write_1h) + output_tokens x output
cost_estimate.no_double_count: thinking tokens are already inside output_tokens and are not added again
cost_estimate.use: operational budget guard (--max-usd). Not the bill.
